说明: 一件乐器两种编制变体,各用不同采样库:SOLO=No Budget Orchestra 独奏,SEC=SSO 第一小提琴声部。下面按变体分别冻结其真实加载的采样。

SOLO.sample_enumeration: constructed the instrument and walked its loaded sample regions; hashes cover exactly the files the engine reads at run time
SOLO.sample_set_hash_algorithm: sort unique asset-root-relative UTF-8 paths; concatenate lowercase '<sha256>  <path>\n>'; SHA-256 the UTF-8 bytes
